# ROI what-if — "Reco widget is not self-serve"

**Generated by `/support-roi` (read-only over the registry). Refreshed for the full half-year: 13 windows W16–W28 (2026-04-13 → 2026-07-12). Omega shard = lower bound.**

## The dev effort being evaluated

Make the **recommendation widget self-serve + richer**:
1. **Self-serve visual builder** — CSS/layout, slider/carousel nav (incl. a site's own carousel), card frames/borders, image positioning, per-device selectors, arbitrary theme placement, "complete the look" multi-product cards — without a developer.
2. **Richer reco config + data** — remove hardcoded algorithm/mechanic caps, multiple algorithms per slot, explicit cart-based rules with fallback, native template-version upgrade (keeping analytics), smart image optimization, tunable/transparent ranking, and richer product data (variants, alt images, Yotpo ratings) in the feed.
3. **Validation + error surfacing** — a misconfigured widget (external system unset, add-to-cart off) shows an error instead of silently returning nothing.

## Toil this would remove — 13 weeks (H1 2026)

| | Tickets | % of support toil | Mechanics |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| **A. Reco "not self-serve" family** (this effort) | **28 / 79** | **35%** | ~178 hand-authored reco mechanics |
| B. Reco reliability bugs (separate "make reco robust" effort) | 12 / 79 | 15% | — |
| **A + B combined reco footprint** | **40 / 79** | **51%** | 178 / 827 = **22% of all custom-code mechanics** |

**Reco is ~half of all personalization support toil, every month, across 13 weeks** — and the single biggest driver of hand-authored custom code. Denominators: 79 kept support tickets, 827 distinct custom-code mechanics (omega lower bound). The 6-week and 13-week reads agree (54%→51%; 38%→35% for family A), so the signal is robust, not an artifact of a few weeks.

### Steadiness (family A, tickets per window)
`04-13:0 · 04-20:2 · 04-27:3 · 05-04:1 · 05-11:1 · 05-18:0 · 05-25:1 · 06-01:4 · 06-08:5 · 06-15:4 · 06-22:3 · 06-29:2 · 07-06:2` — present nearly every week; grows through June as more clients onboard reco.

### Top members (family A, by tickets then mechanics)

- rc-mf-reco-mechanic-limit-visibility — 3 tickets (hardcoded algo/mechanic caps)
- rc-mf-reco-variant-dedup — 2 tickets + **178 mechanics** (dedup/swatches/layout markup)
- rc-mf-reco-theme-slot-injection — 2 tickets + 42 mechanics (placement) · rc-mf-reco-template-upgrade-selfserve — 2 · rc-mf-reco-no-variant-data — 2 · rc-howto-reco-silent-misconfig — 2
- single-ticket: per-device selector, single-algo-per-slot, bundle-discount-on-add, image-optimization, Yotpo-ratings, ranking-opacity, explicit-cart-rules

## Assumptions & caveats

- Omega shard only → a **lower bound**; true figures are higher across shards.
- Per-cause `mechanics` overlap; the 178 is the clean `rc-mf-reco-variant-dedup` reco-markup slice (theme-slot's 42 overlaps it). Don't sum per-cause mechanics.
- A fix rarely removes 100% of a cause; treat 35%/22% as the addressable ceiling. Visual-builder + validation pieces are high-coverage; richer-feed-data (variants/alt-images from Magento/BigCommerce) is partial by nature.
- Backfill weeks W16–W22 used lighter Slack recall (concise) and some Slack tickets are light-attributed from snippets — support-ticket counts for those weeks are a floor.

## Bottom line

A self-serve, richer reco widget is by far the **highest-leverage** personalization investment across the whole half-year: ~35% of support tickets and ~22% of custom-code directly, and reco overall is **~51% of all personalization support toil**. Everything else (pop-up/inline template gap, custom JS targeting, integration ops, per-mechanic bugs) is individually smaller and more scattered.
